entries.final_answer: Semantic/model round-trip: re-parsing the written output yields an equal domain model (parse(write(parse(x))) == parse(x)). No promise of byte-identical text, comment or key-order preservation.

entries.final_answer: Descriptor + one low-complexity leaf artifact kind (tactic). Round-trip proven via a repository port in the domain with a filesystem adapter in infra, exercised for both fetch and write of existing elements. Graph shards, relationships, and the domain graph shape are DEFERRED (future creed/values epic; careful cross-onion-layer modeling). Excluded as needing modeling work: glossary, mission-step-contract, agent-profile, asset. Tactic 'references' carried as an opaque ordered id list, not modeled as domain relationships.
